item.description:

Spend the evening at Montclair Brewery meeting local singles ages 32–43 through a series of quick, easy mini dates. Your first full pour is included. Why This Works: You’re not walking into a crowded bar hoping to meet someone. Everyone in the room is single, in your age range, and there to actually connect. item.title: Kill Goofy — Fri Oct 23, 8:00 AM — Grove Street Theater
item.description:
Apricot Sky Productions’s new play, Kill Goofy by Livingston playwright Eric Alter, opens October 9 and plays for three weekends throught October 25. The story is simple on the surface. Two best friends, inseparable at thirteen, haven’t spoken in thirty years. One of them never left his childhood bedroom. His mother never left because someone had to take care of him. Then the other one comes back to town, and everyone in that house has been keeping the same secret. It’s a play about the things we never say to the people closest to us, and it sends people out the door talking. Please note the play deals with difficult subject matter and is recommended for ages 15 and up. The full synopsis and content advisory plus more information are at https://apricotskyproductions.com/killgoofy. Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

item.description:
Love books and making things? Join the Make Something Book Club, a relaxed gathering where participants can chat about the books they're currently reading while working on a creative project. Bring your knitting, crocheting, needlepoint, embroidery, cross-stitch, quilting, or other portable craft and enjoy conversation with fellow readers and makers.
There is no assigned book—everyone is welcome to share what they're reading, discover new titles, and connect with others in the community while creating something by hand.
Bring a project you're working on, or start something new! Thanks to generous donations from our community, we'll often have a small selection of craft supplies available to share, though materials will vary from meeting to meeting. item.title: Tech Toolbox — Tue Nov 3, 12:30 PM — Montclair Main - Classroom
item.description:
Tech Toolbox is a free hands-on workshop series focused on building real, practical digital skills. Each session zeroes in on a specific skill, program, or tool—from core computer skills and file management to navigating software and online platforms you use every day. Participants are encouraged to bring their own devices and follow along, so you'll leave each session having actually practiced what you learned.
All experience levels are welcome, and your instructor will be there to walk you through everything step by step. Sessions are free and open to the public.
This week's topic is: TBD
Source: Libcal Bccls 10306

item.title: Tech Talks — Tue Nov 3, 3:30 PM — Montclair Main - Classroom
item.description:
Tech Talks is a free informational series where library staff introduce and explain the technology topics that matter most in today's digital world. Each session takes a closer look at a new or complex topic—whether it's a trending app, an emerging technology, or a platform you've been hearing about but aren't quite sure how to navigate. Through demonstrations and clear, jargon-free explanations, you'll come away with a better understanding of the tech landscape around you. There's no hands-on component, so no devices are needed—just come ready to learn and ask questions.
All are welcome regardless of experience level, and time is reserved at the end of each session for Q&A. Sessions are free and open to the public.

item.title: Book Talk: Becoming Roy Lichtenstein — Tue Oct 20, 7:00 PM — Montclair Art Museum
item.description:
Join art historian Avis Berman, author of the forthcoming Becoming Roy Lichtenstein: The Path to Pop, as she explores Roy Lichtenstein’s journey from an obscure artist to a defining figure of American Pop art. The Montclair Art Museum is excited to announce that Mythological Meeting, 1979, Lichtenstein’s only work held in the Museum’s collection, will be on view during Avis Berman’s book talk at MAM. Drawing on extensive archival research and hundreds of interviews, Berman traces Lichtenstein’s early influences, his search for an artistic identity, and the breakthrough that led to Look Mickey in 1961 and the development of his iconic style. The illustrated lecture will feature works of art alongside photographs of Lichtenstein, his friends, and family. Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

item.title: Weekend Warrior Tennis (Sundays) — Sun Nov 1, 9:00 AM
item.description:
North Jersey Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis & More Join us for friendly and sociable free rallies and possibly some informal matches for training and fun. We are beginner to intermediate levels but all are welcome. We don’t allow formal instruction on our group-reserved courts, although giving some quick tips is OK so long as you’re not holding up others waiting to play.
⛑️ **Clinic Matches:** If we have to rotate people in then we may play some clinic-style matches where everyone rotates in evenly. There is no holding the court via wins so everyone has a chance to play regardless of skill level.
🕊️ **Early Bird Start:** If you want to meet earlier than 9 AM (like 8 or 8:30) then please let us know by the day before and we’ll see who can join you (usually I can do earlier).
**🎾 Equipment:** Please bring your own racquet and water, as we don’t provide those. I always have some balls for at least one court, but feel free to bring your own in case we need to branch out over more than one
